name: What is the difference between a smooth stucco finish and a sand finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a smooth stucco finish and a sand finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smooth stucco finish is achieved by using fine aggregate and careful troweling to create a very flat, sleek surface with minimal texture. It offers a modern and minimalist aesthetic. A sand finish, conversely, incorporates sand or larger aggregates, resulting in a slightly gritty, textured appearance that helps to mask minor imperfections. While both are popular, smooth stucco requires a more meticulous application to avoid showing imperfections, whereas a sand finish is more forgiving and provides a subtle, natural look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth stucco is sleek and flat, while sand finish has a slightly gritty texture. Smooth is modern; sand is more natural and forgiving.
